purpose: Corrected, untimed counting evidence. Supersedes the `considered` numbers of 01-microbench.json only; 01 timing stays valid and was not re-run.

supersedes.reason: 01 injected `considered` at the last `pair` loop before the accept anchor. In M and A2 the pair loop is the innermost transition loop, but archived full A enumerates pair -> sequences -> triplets, so its 573 counted outer pair candidates, not leaf (pair, seq, trip) candidates. `accepted` (1183) exceeding that `considered` (573) is the signature of the mismatch. The 01 `considered` values are retained unchanged as raw evidence and are not comparable across variants.
supersedes.retained: 01-microbench.json is kept byte-for-byte: all timing samples, digests and the old counter field remain raw evidence; nothing was re-run, discarded or overwritten.

counting_definition.accepted: incremented immediately before `let extra = ...`; one unit per transition that passed every validity check; must be equal across variants
counting_definition.considered: incremented at the innermost `for` loop whose body contains the accept anchor, i.e. one unit per enumerated leaf transition candidate: M/A2 pair loop (sets -> sequences -> triplets -> pair), MA triplets loop (pair -> sequences -> triplets)
counting_definition.layers: each enclosing transition loop also tallied: ranks, states, sets, pairs, sequences, triplets (`sets` tallies a pre-accept `sets` loop and stays 0 in all three variants, whose only `sets` loop assembles the result table after the accept site)
